senses.gloss: c. (= קלקל׳; קלקל) [refuse,] dunghill. Pesik. Shimʿu, p. 117ᵃ sq. כד הימוט … וכד תרום ק׳ ק׳ שמה when a palace sinks, its name remains palace, and when a dunghill rises, its name remains dunghill.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:8">Lam. R. to IV, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00860"><he>טְרַף</he> I</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>קִיקְלַיָּא</he>, <he>קִיקְלֵי</he>, <cite ref="S00596"><he>קוּ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="S01143"><he>קִקְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Keritot 6a">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>על קיקלי דמתא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אקִילְקֵי</he>, Rashi <cite ref="S01411"><he>קִלְקֵי</he></cite>) rather dwell on the dunghills of Matha Meḥasia, than in the palaces of Pumb’ditha.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>בקיקליא דמתא</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <he>בקלקולי</he>) on the dunghills of the town.
<cite ref="Pesachim 114a">Pes. 114ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01867"><he>קָקוּלָא</he></cite>; a. e.—V. <cite ref="S01147"><he>קִיקֶלְתָּא</he></cite>.
